seoTitle: Aelnir PDF Tools: edit, compress and sign PDFs offline on Android
summary: View, organise, compress, convert, OCR, redact, protect and sign PDFs entirely on your phone.
tagline: A full PDF toolkit that never uploads a file. No all-files access, no camera permission, no account.

features.title: Every PDF job, offline
features.lead: The PDF engines run in isolated processes on your phone and hold no permissions.

items.title: View and organise
items.body: Open, reorder, rotate, merge, split and extract pages.

items.title: Compress and convert
items.body: Shrink a PDF by recompressing its images, or convert pages to and from images.

items.title: OCR
items.body: Turn scanned pages into searchable text, on the device.

items.title: Redact and protect
items.body: Black out sensitive content, and add or remove a password.

items.title: Sign
items.body: Add a signature and fill forms.

items.title: Private by design
items.body: No uploads. Files are opened only when you pick them, with no all-files access.

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Your documents stay on your phone
note.body: Aelnir PDF Tools is free and supported by ads. Every file is processed on your device and nothing is uploaded.

privacy.headline: Your documents never leave your phone.
privacy.lead: The app needs no account and has no server. PDFs are opened, edited and saved on your device, with no all-files access and no camera permission. The free app shows ads through Google AdMob, whose SDK collects limited device and usage data, never your documents.

studioProof.hard: PDFium and qpdf, cross-compiled and run in isolated processes, behind one job pipeline from worker to OCR to verification.
